title: Exact all-minimisers enumeration and the unknown-support erasure threshold at K >= 5 and at panel scale
question: Can the complete set of minimum-size strict source supports be decided exactly without the C(|E|,K) brute force Stage290 used, by enumerating only the O(K)-local deficit supports, zero faces, minimum covers and lifts?
Does the resulting routine agree with brute force wherever brute force is affordable?

Is the Stage290 finding -- that the adversarial (nearest-to-source) erasure threshold does not grow with panel size while the random one does -- still true at K = 5 and above, and on reference panels spanning more than two orders of magnitude in size?

method.all_minimisers: Backbone projection (frozen observed_backbone); leaf envelope and baseline mass (frozen two_pass_envelope / inverse); admissible deficit supports from the FROZEN generator deficit_sets under the weighted deficit bound sum(deg-2) <= K-2 and 3 <= deg <= K; zero faces of the affine mass map over A = S u N(S), reduced by the forced-positivity of N(S)\S vertices with non-negative baseline; exact strict feasibility by the frozen Stage43 common-slack vertex routine; ALL minimum atom covers of each feasible pattern; and all original-edge lifts of every atom, each decided by the frozen Stage25 exact rational endpoint oracle fixed_support_polytope.
exhaustiveness_rests_on: the weighted deficit bound and positive-anchor growth implemented by the frozen deficit_sets generator, imported and not re-derived here
the exactness of the frozen Stage25 endpoint polytope oracle
the lift candidate lists being supersets of the true lifts
method.minimum_cross_check: every call also runs the frozen solve_partial and records its minimum; a mismatch is reported as a disagreement and never silently repaired
method.threshold_convention: Stage290's: t_unknown is the largest e along a fixed removal order for which the set of all minimum-size supports is exactly the single true support; found by exponential bracketing then bisection with both bracket endpoints explicitly evaluated; MIN_REMAINING = 3 references are never erased; a probe with an indecisive status aborts the regime as unknown_probe rather than counting as failure.

tracks.validate_A: every probe point recorded in results/stage290_bridge.jsonl (130 cases x 5 regimes x the probes of each bisection) plus e = 0, recomputed with the new routine and re-run with the Stage290 brute force; cases with <= 70 edges also get the prefilter-free exhaustive brute force
tracks.validate_B: 500 freshly generated small instances (7-12 leaves, K in 1..4, random hidden-leaf subsets) compared support-set for support-set against the complete C(|E|,k) enumeration, and the reduced zero-face enumeration compared against the full 2^|A| one
tracks.bridge: all 893 exactly-explainable bank cases, K in {2,3,5,7,10,12}, five regimes each
tracks.panels: planted mixtures on the frozen 47,151-leaf WoL v2 placement panel sub-sampled to 64...47151 leaves and on the 15,953-leaf WoL v2 backbone sub-sampled to 100/1000/15953, K in {3,5}, three seeds, adversarial and random regimes

claim_boundary.planted_instances: the panel-ladder mixtures are PLANTED by the rule in scripts/stage292_panels.py, not published mixtures; they vary panel size at a fixed generative process and carry no biological claim
claim_boundary.resource_stops: a non-complete routine status is recorded as such and never read as a uniqueness verdict
claim_boundary.what_t_unknown_is_not: t_unknown is a property of one removal ORDER, not a worst case over all erasure sets; the worst case over sets is the known-support cogirth quantity

safety: New files only under stage 292; no pre-existing file is modified.
